answer: Gate entry on earned reputation, not a password: every identity starts at zero and climbs only by completing verified useful work, with its score decaying if it goes idle. A sybil farmer can saw timber all day, but each fake must saw its own - reputation cannot be copied from one account to another, so ten thousand clones need ten thousand honest workloads. A single pearl of genuine work stands out on a flat mesa of empty accounts: the cost is real effort per identity, and the limit is that reputation oracles must stay honest, since a captured verifier can mint trust for free.
